base_observation_only_audit.interpretation: descriptor margin/entropy and raw/nested reprojection diagnostics do not cleanly separate the rare top16-rescuable carriers across families

candidate_multimodality_audit.interpretation: spatial candidate multimodality carries substantially more expansion-need signal than score entropy alone, but the 13-positive rare-event sample is too small for a stable family-disjoint expansion classifier

scientific_conclusion: Do not freeze a rare-event expand/not-expand classifier from this panel. Prefer a deterministic retention rule that preserves multiple spatial modes inside a small bounded K, then test whether this recovers the top16 hard-tail coverage without requiring prediction of the rare expansion event.
